themes.name: Agentic AI in research
themes.description: Focuses on AI agents that can autonomously conduct research, analyze data, and execute research tasks.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Covers AI tools that assist developers in writing, debugging, and reviewing code.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Encompasses a broad range of AI-powered tools designed to aid researchers in their work, from data analysis to literature review.

themes.name: AI product research
themes.description: Articles discussing how AI is applied to understand markets, competitors, and user needs for product development.

themes.name: AI summarization
themes.description: Covers AI applications for condensing large amounts of text, research papers, or feedback into concise summaries.

themes.name: AI workforce impact
themes.description: Focuses on the research and analysis of how AI is changing job roles, skills, and employment landscapes.

themes.name: AI sentiment feedback
themes.description: Articles about using AI to analyze and understand user sentiment, opinions, and feedback from various sources.

themes.name: AI chatbot research
themes.description: Explores the research and development of AI chatbots, including their capabilities, limitations, and user interactions.

themes.name: AI design research
themes.description: Discusses AI's role in the design process, including tools and methodologies for creating user experiences and interfaces.

themes.name: Synthetic users
themes.description: Covers the creation and use of artificial or simulated user data and personas for testing and research.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
